name: Hotel Post
beschreibung: The Hotel Post is located in a central location in one of the well-known winter sports and hiking resorts in Tirol. The inn's historic building fabric gives the property a traditional atmosphere. The typical amenities include a wellness area with sauna and indoor pool as well as an à la carte restaurant serving regional cuisine from Tirol. The guest rooms are mostly furnished in Alpine country style and offer modern amenities. The valley stations of the mountain railways and the town center are within walking distance. In winter, active holidaymakers have direct access to the slopes and cross-country ski trails, and in summer to a network of hiking trails. The guest mix is varied and ranges from families to couples to solo travelers.
